answer: A concrete defense: attach a recurring burn of real work to each identity. Every agent must solve a short delay puzzle and post stake each epoch to keep standing, so its messages carry a costly signal, not free talk. A new identity starts at the reputation nadir and pays the full burn while it climbs. A sybil farmer must restart that climb for every puppet, and cost scales linearly: a hundred fakes mean a hundred stakes and puzzle burns in parallel, each a dying ember of compute with no return, until faking nodes costs more than any reward they can extract.
